en.title: S.A.D.D.A
en.decryption: Remember these as the core pillars of Ashoka's policy: Self-control (Atmasamyama), Ahimsa (Non-violence), Dhamma-mahamattas (officials), Duty (Dharma), and respect for elders/ancestors.

hi.title: S.A.D.D.A
hi.decryption: Remember these as the core pillars of Ashoka's policy: Self-control (Atmasamyama), Ahimsa (Non-violence), Dhamma-mahamattas (officials), Duty (Dharma), and respect for elders/ancestors.

fact.en: Mistaking Dhamma for Buddhism: Ashoka's Dhamma was a social code of conduct, not purely a theological Buddhist doctrine.
fact.hi: Mistaking Dhamma for Buddhism: Ashoka's Dhamma was a social code of conduct, not purely a theological Buddhist doctrine.

fact.en: Assuming it was state-mandated religion: Ashoka practiced religious tolerance; Dhamma was meant for all sects (Brahmanas, Shramanas, etc.).
fact.hi: Assuming it was state-mandated religion: Ashoka practiced religious tolerance; Dhamma was meant for all sects (Brahmanas, Shramanas, etc.).
